title: Step 13 — User Flow
description: Map the step-by-step paths users will take through the solution to accomplish their goals. Define entry points, decision points, and success states.

flows.description: User flows as structured sequences with entry/exit conditions and typed steps.

title.description: Flow name (e.g., 'Create New Project', 'Work Through a Step').

trigger.description: What initiates this flow — the entry point.

success_state.description: What 'done' looks like — the exit condition for the happy path.

type.description: action = user does something, system = app/AI processes, screen = what the user sees, decision = a branching point.

steps.description: Ordered sequence from trigger to success state.

alternate_paths.description: Non-happy-path branches — error states, rejections, edge cases.

mvp_scope_notes.description: Notes on what is in/out of MVP scope for user flows.
